title.narrative: Modernizing Public Institutions and Systems in Yemen

description.narrative: The project will lay the foundation to modernize key core state functions to enable service delivery and foster economic development. Developing the system of national accounts and managing public finances and human resources, including payroll, are key to adequate public resource management, as well as service delivery to citizens and businesses.
To strengthen the public statistical, financial and human resource systems and management.
